title: "Active pod" after EROS pod error prevents starting new pod
symptom: After deactivating and removing an Omnipod EROS pod, AAPS shows 'pod-activation in progress' and a pop-up message saying no pod active. It is not possible to discard this non-existent pod activation, and no new pod can be activated. The system assumes a pod is connected and in initialization, causing activation to abort before cannula setting. This makes the app unusable, and the only workaround is loading an old setup file from AAPS 2.8.2.
evidence_quote: Pod can be deactivated and removed from system with AAPS menu tools, but afterwards I get information like "pod-activation in progress" (in Omnipod-menu), and at the same time a pop-up-message, no pod active. It's not possible to discard this (not existing) pod-activation. No new pod can be acitvated, the systems assumes there is a pod connected which is in the initalization process.
